objectives.label: Carry the offer of trade to {recipient} in {target}

title: Trade for {settlement}
Letters to the merchants of {target}
summary: {settlement} needs new trade. Carry {giver}'s offer to {recipient} in {target}, {distance} to the {direction}.
offer: Nobody comes to buy any more. I have written to {recipient} in {target} offering our goods cheap — carry the letter, and pray they bite.
complete: They will send a caravan! You may have saved us.
